study_design: Prospective nested case-control study using prediagnostic serum from a cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: After a surveillance period of over 23 years, 136 tissue-confirmed incident cases of prostate cancer were identified. Their stored sera and those of 136 matched controls were measured for the following: 25-hydroxyvitamin D, 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D, calcium, phosphorus, and parathyroid hormone.
reason: The study examines tissue-confirmed incident prostate cancer overall after prospective surveillance. No aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal endpoint is defined or analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The ORs for the highest quartiles relative to the lowest were 0.8 (95 percent confidence interval [CI] = 0.4-1.8) for 25-hydroxyvitamin D and 1.0 (CI = 0.5-2.1) for 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D.
estimate_classifications.reason: The odds ratio is for prostate cancer overall, with no aggressive subtype specified.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There were no notable differences between cases and controls in their median serum levels of the five laboratory measurements.
estimate_classifications.reason: Phosphorus was one of the five measured serum factors, and the cases were general incident prostate cancer cases; no aggressive endpoint was analyzed.
